summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (after print): joins str(obj) with sep and calls self.print once with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False, plus the passed style, highlight (default True), and end. Added a CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under 9.0.0 Added, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after Logging, and tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus test_out_no_objects, markup, emoji, containers, no_crop, style, highlight_default, highlight_none, highlight_false, render_hook), with RenderHook added to the existing import. Tests were not run per instructions; verification was by reading only. No commits made.
